state.approved_rules: PA-27: one or two primaries; pending reserves capacity but cannot justify release. Member atomically orders mark with suspend/deprovision and only active non-guests accept. Permission needs current member mark and exact completed source seat. Callbacks are private system commands using source proof. Client creates stable tenant UUID; exact original creation retry succeeds, changed intent conflicts. Source reads are not global cross-stream transactions. Analyze concrete bounded code; no model judgment is runtime proof.

release_last.instructions: Does PrimaryOrgAdmins.Release allow the last completed primary to be released when the only other seat is pending?

third_seat.instructions: Can PrimaryOrgAdmins.Designate create a third seat while two pending/completed seats already exist?

late_mark_restore.instructions: Can Member.MarkPrimary restore an old released primary mark on a duplicate of the same designation token after UnmarkPrimary removed it?

late_unmark_clear.instructions: Can UnmarkPrimary for an older designation remove a newer designation mark?

forged_outcome.instructions: Does RecordPrimaryMarkOutcomeHandler accept a supplied user/episode that does not match the member outcome used as its source proof?

unreleased_unmark.instructions: Does UnmarkMemberPrimaryHandler let a system callback remove a primary mark without a matching committed source release?

released_authority.instructions: Does the shown final permission logic grant primary authority from a leftover Member mark after the matching source seat has been released?

circular_activation.instructions: Does ActivateTenantHandler still require a positive permission decision or membership projection that in turn requires the tenant to already be active?

server_creation_id.instructions: Does RegisterTenant still provide an omitted-ID default or constructor that creates the tenant ID in the backend rather than requiring the client to supply it?
